run_interop_matrix_tests: run gRPC interop tests across languages and releases using docker images from Google Container Registry
get_test_images_for_lang: get docker image tags and paths for a given language across releases and runtimes
read_test_cases_file: read test case commands from a bash-like testcase file for a language and release
generate_test_case_jobspecs: generate JobSpec objects from testcase file lines with server host overrides and flake retry settings
pull_images_for_lang: pull and warm up all docker images for a language from the container registry in parallel
